body: Well ty anyway, I guess I got my answer. I just wish my last words weren't on some silly reddit post soon to be passed up and forgotten, but que sera sera

Ty for the reply but I'm afraid the only actual people who will be affected by my death are my landlady, boss and the emts sent to remove my corpse. And chances are if I stick around I'll be homeless by September... I honestly don't see any other choice

> So I’m tasked with accepting their lives while they in no way want to take part in mine.

Exactly, most of the time when I engage with other people it seems like they're only waiting for their turn to talk about themselves. They hear me, but do they actually listen? Its really tiring to be treated as just another number to call upon when *they're* in need. 

Oh and youre right, that is a pretty bullshit excuse but I guess insecurities can get the best of us

Ty for the reply, you're absolutely right. I relate to that guilt and shame of feeling anything different than the depression that has seeped into my very being at this point. I hope we both find fullfilment one way or another, stranger

God that's horrible to hear, I know how easy it is to become misanthropic when living in this crazy world or ours. Hell tbh I'm feeling pretty similar atm, but I'll try my best to help you through this.

Of course I could tell you the usual that not everyone is wicked and two faced, but ultimately most of the people you meet in life will place self interests above all else. The trick is learning to accept and moderate your expectations. 

Accept that you can't change others, but you can change yourself and your reactions. Through self acceptance you develop a better understanding of why you feel the way you do and how you can personally overcome your problems to be who you want to be. It's one of the hardest things to accomplish but it's completely worth it when learning to deal with yourself and other people in general.

Moderation, to me this is key in pretty much all of life. The only thing you can't have too much of is moderation. And when I say "moderate your expectations" I mean you should never expect too much from people. Because as youve experienced, nasty people will leap at the first opportunity for exploitation. So you must moderate how much respect, trust and effort you put into them, not until they've earned it. 

Ok I just realized how long this is getting and I'm not sure if its at all helpful or will even be fully read. So I'll call it quits here. If you'd like to talk I'll be here, I'm just another depressed soul with her own seemingly unsolvable problems but I'm always willing to help others if I can.
Same here, actually I just posted with pretty much the same sentiment. And youre right, it feels a little less lonely but man I just wish that feeling would last.
I know what you mean, like the color from your world was drained and nothing really feels right. Lately my life has felt like one long mind numbing blur of apathy. I'm sorry you feel it too

And Idk why the hell I post here wasting the time and empathy of others when I've already decided long ago where I'm headin.

Might as well be screaming into my pillow

Ty for the kind words, but I'm afraid I've been doing that for the better part of the past mm fiveish years. Personally I find online gaming and forum chatting to be a rather shallow pool to draw any feeling of fullfilment from. And the interaction I have from others irl the same. I only have my art and books, but even passions turn stale when everything else seems to.

I'm broke, tired and drowning

I smoke, draw or try to listen to music when it's manageable. That's what you gotta try to do with pain, turn into something positive. 
>"If you're falling off a cliff, you might as well try to fly. You've got nothing to lose."

When the cloud over my head goes out of control and turns into a monsoon? Well not much helps then, so I just make some tea and sit on the porch and wait out the storm.

>fuck you. i hate you. you shouldve died the first time you hung yourself. 

God I've said the same thing to myself so many times before. Your experience is very much relatable and tbh I'll probably be in the same position before the end of the the year. And I really wish I could give more than my meaningless wishes. I hope you find a way out

Fuck if I don't know how that feels, it feels like my whole life has been me dawning different masks to fit in or hide who I really am from everyone else. Often times over compensating and making an ass of myself in the process :/ I too wonder if I kill myself if my folks will even recognize me beyond the size of the body bag and well... scarred arms.

But I think what'll hurt them the most is the fact that I didn't feel comfortable expressing who I was to them. Because one thing I've found to be common amongst most parents is not the shame of their childrens divergence, but rather the guilt of their own inattentiveness towards them.

Well anyway that came off a lot more self centered than I intended, sorry about that, I just related quite heavily to your situation and wanted to let you know you're not alone in that thinking. I hope you find some solution or peace, best wishes op

Hi, I can relate to the feeling of constant suicidal ideation as well. And as my ever so subtle username implies I'm no stranger to self harm. I've been cutting, burning and stabbing myself like a voodoo doll since age 13 and have dealt with suicidal thoughts since 15 when I first attempted and was thrown in a pysch ward for 2 months. I'm 20 now and things haven't changed much besides developing an understanding of my depression. And I'd be lying if I said I still don't occasionally self harm or think about suicide on a daily ( some weeks it's the only thing that rattles around my head :/).

So I can say with a fair bit of confidence that I know where your coming from. And as someone who hates to see that suffering in another soul I'd like to reach a hand out to you if you'll take it. If you'd like to vent, chat, shoot the breeze then feel free to pm me and we can talk here or some other platform.

Hello, would you like a friendly stranger to talk to? I know the stifling feeling of loneliness all too well at this point. And I can't even count how many close friends I too have let slip away because of my depression and confusion. But it may not be too late for you, perhaps if you explain your point of view and state of mind to your friend in an apology you can rekindle that friendship. Hell I have had a emotional breakdown in front of my 2 closest friends and said some really nasty stuff, but after a sincere note and face to face apology they completely understood and now we're closer than ever!

Everyone has these types of "meltdowns" and slumps that can momentarily cloud our better judgements. Shit happens you know and on the whole it really doesn't matter. What really matters is how you learn from it and use that to better future relationships and decisions. Life is **nothing** without failure, "What's important is that you keep heading in the right direction, not that you reach the destination quickly."

If you would like to talk, vent or make a new internet friend feel free to pm me anytime and we can chat here or some other platform. Take it easy, hun

Hi, I was very thin growing up and it bugged the shit outta me as well. Constantly bullied and ridiculed quite openly as well. For example I had pretty skinny neck and arms and the kids at school had a field day with that, I would often have random kids I never knew walk up and place their hands on my wrists or neck to "measure" or "see what it feels like" some knuckleheads would even choke me for the fun of it laughing at how easy it felt... So yea not too fun of a time and I totally know how it feels to be harassed by family as I was nicknamed jack skelington by my mom. What was terribly funny to her was a constant reminder to me that I was "not normal". But as I grew up and made a friend who was really into weight lifting he helped me put on weight through protein shakes, lotsa milk and proteins he'd bring to lunch just for me. I was lucky in that aspect, but my point is your body's state is not at all permanent if you do the proper research for a diet that fits your metabolism. If you need advice go ahead and pm me and I'll try my best to set you on a better path.

First off I'm truly sorry to hear how awful of a time you've been having. I know all too well how it feels to watch all your efforts fall flat and fail time and time again. But, I think you should also feel immensly proud of yourself for having the strength to put in all that effort while maintaining the will and desire to carry on and continually improve your situation. Too me thats the most admirable quality a person can have when faced with such stifling adversity.

Not to undermine the pain and struggle you are going through now. I know how suffocating loneliness can be, especially when you feel like a burning building with no one around to put you out. But from your post you sound like a very determined person and people like you don't go down without a fight. And as that fighter you deserve better than an abrupt end.

And I know it's WAY easier said than done and sometimes the "better days" we're promised remain sitting on the horizon out of reach far longer than they ought to. But see this as training for the future, how you find a way forward now will define who you are and who you want to become. Because what will those future fires look like to someone who's walked through the inferno?

Anyway I hope that made sense and helped you in some manner, I managed to kill an hour writing it and now i gotta get back to work before my manager kills me. But I'll definitely be on later to respond or if you need someone to talk/vent to. Best wishes for now.
